title: We Have Everything We Need
speaker: Hoka Chris Fortin
summary: The talk's main teaching is that true freedom and awakening come from embracing our imperfections and uncertainties, rather than trying to overcome or achieve something specific. By letting go of our need for control and perfection, we can cultivate inner love and tenderness towards ourselves and others, and embody intimacy and presence in every moment. This approach encourages us to trust ourselves, stay present, and find wonder and connection in the simplicity of life.
